name: B10-0588/2025 (Renew) – Mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the kidnapping of more than 300 students and 12 staff from St Mary's Catholic School in Papiri, Nigeria, on 21 November, and of 25 children in Maga on 18 November. It calls for the immediate release of all captives. It urges Nigeria to protect schools better, investigate these crimes independently, and prosecute those responsible. It also asks the European Union to give Nigeria more practical support. The text is a statement of position and demands; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament demands the release of all kidnapped children and teachers.
- **Who it affects:** Kidnapped students and staff, their families, and children in northern Nigeria.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the EU Council, Commission and Nigerian government.
